```{r}
#set up working directory and packages 
setwd("C:/kanes stuff/uni work/year 2/semester 2/Survey Design/R code")
getwd()
pacman::p_load(haven, tidyverse, knitr, weights)
p18229_bsa23_archive_final <- read_dta("C:/kanes stuff/uni work/year 2/semester 2/Survey Design/data/p18229-bsa23-archive-final.dta")

#variables to keep in data set 
keep_vars <- c("EURefVote", "HhldEdu", "BSA23_final_wt")
var <- p18229_bsa23_archive_final[, keep_vars]

rm(p18229_bsa23_archive_final)
#removing missingness
table(var$EURefVote)
table(var$HhldEdu)

var$EURefVote[var$EURefVote == 8] <-NA
var$EURefVote[var$EURefVote == 9] <-NA
var$EURefVote[var$EURefVote == -1] <-NA

var$HhldEdu[var$HhldEdu == 8] <-NA
var$HhldEdu[var$HhldEdu == 9] <-NA
var$HhldEdu[var$HhldEdu == -1] <-NA

var <- var %>% drop_na()

#renaming results 
var <- var %>%
  mutate(
    EURefVote = case_when(
      EURefVote == 1 ~ "Remain",
      EURefVote == 2 ~ "Leave"))

var <- var %>%
  mutate(
    HhldEdu = case_when(
      HhldEdu == 1 ~ "Degree Level",
      HhldEdu == 2 ~ "Below Degree Level"))

#frequency tabe 
table1 <- var %>% 
  select(HhldEdu, EURefVote) %>% 
  table() %>% 
  addmargins() %>% 
as.data.frame.matrix()
table1

table <- var %>% 
  select(HhldEdu, EURefVote) %>% 
  table()

prop_table <- prop.table(table, margin = 1)%>% 
  `*`(100) %>% 
  as.data.frame.matrix()
prop_table

#chi-square test 
chisq <- chisq.test(var$EURefVote, var$HhldEdu)
chisq

#chi-square test weighted 
wtd_chisq <- wtd.chi.sq(var$EURefVote, var$HhldEdu, weight = var$BSA23_final_wt)
wtd_chisq
